reason: The README clearly indicates the plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is audible completion alerting within the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with configurable notification behavior and scope; this maps to notifications/monitoring functionality. No additional sensitive capabilities are evidenced.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 增加会话完成提示，会在任务输出结束时播放音效，并在设置中提供通知开关、声音和音量等选项。
summaries.en: This plugin adds completion alerts for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI sessions by playing a sound when output finishes, with settings to enable notifications, choose a sound, and set volume and scope.

capabilities: Plays chime notifications when a DeepSeek Harness session finishes output
Provides user-configurable notification options (enable/disable, sound, volume, and target session type)
Stores settings in browser localStorage for persistence

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as "Completion sound notifications" that plays a sound when a session output finishes and adds notification options under Settings.
README states it is a pure web plugin with no host service/tool/session-log entry, and settings persist in browser localStorage.
